open_operator_decisions.decision: Does WP-KERNEL-012 leave eframe/egui-wgpu and kumihimo-egui for pure Vulkan, and when? In-flight pins and MT-198's verified capability point the other way.
Vulkan binding crate: name it, or delegate to the MT-203 owner as recorded. Affects unsafe policy in render-gpu.
Does D7 reach naga and WGSL as a source language, or only wgpu? Decides whether 2942 shader lines are compiled or rewritten.
Boundary between the shell's UI and control layer (Handshake prerequisite) and Kumihimo's renderer crate (D8): who owns text, IME, AccessKit and widget drawing.
Where the control mechanic lives: STU-ARC-023 says Kumihimo is single owner, code and RF-05 have it in hsk-studio-controls, Kumihimo core has none.
How GUI work proceeds until the layer exists: wait entirely, allow window-free Viewer logic lanes only (today's practice), or build a non-egui asset-local Vulkan test host.
May render-gpu be refactored behind its port (separating plan logic from device calls) before the owner exists, or is that 'new wgpu code'?
Platform scope after D7: macOS without Metal, and Windows machines without a usable Vulkan driver once DX12 rows retire.
D3 was never answered by the Operator; the lead reading stands (Studio defines the client port, Handshake the owner).
Spec-owner items D7A-01..17 and SD-31..52 PROPOSED remain unreviewed.
